description: Source code for initializing variables and data structures in a shader compiler, including functions for zero-initialization sequences, loop-based array initialization, and variable setup within the ANGLE project.

classes.name: InitializeLocalsTraverser
classes.description: AST traverser class for initializing local variables in shader code.

methods.name: CreateZeroInitAssignment
methods.description: Creates an assignment node that assigns zero to a given variable.

methods.name: AddZeroInitSequence
methods.description: Adds zero-initialization sequence for a variable, handling arrays, structs, and simple types.

methods.name: AddStructZeroInitSequence
methods.description: Recursively adds zero-initialization for struct members.

methods.name: AddArrayZeroInitStatementList
methods.description: Adds zero-initialization statements for array elements.

methods.name: AddArrayZeroInitForLoop
methods.description: Adds a loop to initialize array elements to zero.

methods.name: AddArrayZeroInitSequence
methods.description: Chooses between loop or statement list for array initialization based on size and qualifiers.

methods.name: InsertInitCode
methods.description: Inserts initialization code for variables at the start of main shader function.

methods.name: CreateInitCode
methods.description: Generates initialization code sequence for a variable.

methods.name: InitializeUninitializedLocals
methods.description: Initializes local variables that are uninitialized within the shader AST.

methods.name: InitializeVariables
methods.description: Initializes variables in the shader AST, including global and local variables.
